snippet.title: Fate of Fire:Kyvedy Guardiah - Trailer -
snippet.description:
"Fate of Fire: Kyvedy Guardiah" is a story driven JRPG with both Action and Turn based combat. 
A Tale of Love, Hope and Struggle set in a Cursed world with only Seven days left.

"..to gain immortality, humanity challenged Death..
..but Defeat shattered their dreams of Glory..  
..and Despair sat on the throne of Hope.. 
..as the Aeon's might was beyond their reach..
..a curse was cast upon them.. "

Now, with only Seven days left, you must guide Nine heroes in a journey to change the Fate of the world... or humanity will die..

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3085800/Fate_of_Fire_Kyvedy_Guardiah/

Music "Call to swords" by Tim Beek https://timbeek.com/

Made with LÖVE https://love2d.org/
